# WhereTo30A

> A reader-first local guide and business directory for Scenic Highway 30A and Florida's Emerald Coast — beach towns, restaurants, shops, activities, services, and editorial trip guides.

WhereTo30A helps visitors and locals discover what to do, where to eat, and which town fits their trip along 30A and South Walton.

## Primary hubs

- [Home](https://whereto30a.com/): Featured picks, search, and entry points across the corridor
- [Beach towns](https://whereto30a.com/towns): Town guides for Rosemary Beach, Seaside, Alys Beach, WaterColor, Grayton Beach, and more
- [Areas & districts](https://whereto30a.com/areas): Town centers, shopping districts, and gathering spots
- [Local businesses](https://whereto30a.com/businesses): Directory of storefront and venue listings by category
- [Restaurants on 30A](https://whereto30a.com/businesses/restaurants): Eat by town along Scenic 30A
- [Shopping on 30A](https://whereto30a.com/businesses/shopping): Boutiques, town centers, and local stores
- [Food & drink](https://whereto30a.com/businesses/food-and-drink): Rollup into restaurants, coffee, bars, and related types
- [Travel guides](https://whereto30a.com/guides): Editorial planning and on-the-ground advice

## Editorial guides

- [Ultimate 30A first-timer guide](https://whereto30a.com/guide/ultimate-30a-first-timers-guide): Planning overview for first-time visitors

## Policies

- [About](https://whereto30a.com/about): Mission, editorial approach, and how listings are handled
- [Privacy](https://whereto30a.com/privacy): Analytics, accounts, and data practices
- [Terms](https://whereto30a.com/terms): Site use and disclaimers

## Optional

- [List your business](https://whereto30a.com/list-your-business): Request a new or updated listing
- [Listing feedback](https://whereto30a.com/feedback): Report accuracy issues or suggest improvements
